ReleaseBot: Heads-up: rolling release v2.14 scheduled for 02:00 UTC. This rollout will apply the new vpc-egress-auditgate policy to eu-west-1 (audit sampling + deny for non-approved egress). Pls see runbook: https://internal.redwood/release/v2.14/runbook :warning:
Alex R: Noted. Quick Q — do we have a canary subset? last time similar egress tighten blocked keystore warmups for GPU nodes.
Maya (infra): We do one-region canary but the policy is global in the tf module. My concern: policy currently denies egress to any external IP not on allowlist; keystore/kms talks via privatelink IPs and some control-plane endpoints will fail unless we allow them explicitly.
Priya (sec): We can add an allowlist for specific keystore/KMS FQDNs via DNS-based exceptions, but we prefer tag-based SG exceptions so it's auditable. We should avoid blanket 0.0.0.0/0 opens.
Dan (oncall): Seeing warmup errors in staging eu-west-1 earlier today after a smoke run: attaching snippet —
OpsBot: `ERROR 2026-02-14T18:12:34Z warmup: keystore handshake failed: TLS alert: handshake failure -> dial tcp 10.23.45.67:443: i/o timeout`
Maya (infra): That 10.23.45.67 is privatelink-keystore-eu. If policy denies privatelink egress traffic path, nodes can't fetch bootstrap keys.
Alex R: Can we pause the rollout until infra and sec agree on an exception? I'd rather delay 30m than cause a node-onboard rollback.
ReleaseBot: Rollout paused (manual hold) by request of Alex R. Use `release resume 3155556789` to continue.
Maya (infra): Proposal: create a scoped SG exception tag `allow:keystore-eu` applied to warmup instances and a tf patch to make the auditgate deny only for unknown endpoints. Minimal change:
OpsBot: ```hcl
# tf snippet
resource "aws_security_group_rule" "allow_keystore_eu" {
  type        = "ingress"
  from_port   = 443
  to_port     = 443
  protocol    = "tcp"
  cidr_blocks = ["10.23.45.0/24"]
  description = "allow keystore privatelink for warmup nodes"
}
```
Priya (sec): Sounds fine as long as we lock the rule to the privatelink CIDR and add an audit tag. Also request: keep audit sampling at debug for keystore calls for 24h so we can validate.
Maya (infra): Note: debug sampling for audit logs in eu-west-1 will increase CloudWatch/LogStorage cost ~+$2k/mo if we keep full retention. Suggest 7-day retention for debug sampling logs, then drop to normal.
Alex R: Agree with 7 days. We can cherry-pick the rule to the canary ASG first then apply to all gpu warmup ASGs if canary green.
Dan (oncall): I'll watch: set up dashboard and alert on `keystore.handshake_failures > 0` for 10m. Slack alert to #eng-oncall and #eng-infra.
Priya (sec): Approve exception flow. Make sure TF change includes `approved_by = "Priya (sec)"` in description so auditors can trace.
Maya (infra): I'll open a quick PR now, will link here. PR will: 1) add scoped SG rule; 2) set audit sampling=debug for keystore events in eu-west-1 with 7d retention; 3) add terraform var to limit scope.
Alex R: Plan: Maya patches + PR, Priya reviews & sign-off, Dan monitors canary, Alex resumes if green. Owners: Maya, Priya, Dan, Alex. Resume command once Dan thumbs up.
OpsBot: Quick revert commands if we see regressions: `tf apply -target=module.vpc_egress_auditgate` or `release rollback v2.14 --stage eu-west-1`.
Dan (oncall): I see canary infra deployed to eu-west-1 staging; monitoring live. Will report back in 15m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Alex R: thanks — appreciate the fast coordination. :thumbsup:
